1. QB Reader is a text-based quizbowl question reader. Play some questions on your own:
2. Or, join a multiplayer room to play against other people:
3. New to QB Reader? Check out tips and instructions:
4. QB Reader comes with a searchable database of questions which have been downloaded and parsed from https://quizbowlpackets.com/.
5. Answerlines have been aggregated into frequency lists by category.
6. The questions are parsed using the Python or JavaScript packet parser.
7. Sign up for an account to track your stats, and play geoword. If you already have an account, login here. To find out more about what an account can do, check out the about page.
8. Most features of QB Reader can be accessed through the API. You can also use the python wrapper to interact with the API.
9. You can also directly view the Github source code and the answer checking code as an npm package.
